title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
description: Classic creamy tuna noodles with peas and a crisp buttery crumb topping.

steps.text: Heat oven to 375°F. Cook 8 oz egg noodles until just tender, then drain.
Mix noodles with 2 drained cans tuna, 1 can cream of mushroom soup, 3/4 cup milk, 1 cup frozen peas, and the optional 1/2 cup cheddar.
Spread in a 2-quart baking dish. Toss 3/4 cup breadcrumbs with 2 tablespoons melted butter and scatter over the top.
Bake 25–30 minutes until bubbling and golden on top.

title: Sheet-Pan Lemon Garlic Tilapia & Green Beans
description: A light, quick sheet-pan dinner with lemony tilapia and tender green beans.

steps.text: Toss 12 oz green beans with 1 tablespoon olive oil, 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder, 1/4 teaspoon salt, and pepper. Roast 5 minutes.
Add 4 tilapia fillets to the pan. Brush with the remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil and season with remaining garlic powder and salt.
Squeeze half the lemon over everything and roast 8–10 minutes, until the fish flakes easily. Serve with the remaining lemon.

title: Sheet-Pan Gnocchi & Vegetables
description: Shelf-stable gnocchi roasts crisp at the edges with colorful vegetables.

steps.text: Toss 16 oz gnocchi, 1 chopped bell pepper, 1 chopped zucchini, and 1 cup cherry tomatoes with 2 tablespoons olive oil, 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning, and 1/2 teaspoon salt.
Spread on a sheet pan in one layer and roast 20–25 minutes, stirring once, until the gnocchi are browned at the edges and vegetables are tender.
Sprinkle with the optional 1/4 cup Parmesan before serving.

title: Turkey & Cheese Pinwheel Wraps
description: Fast lunch pinwheels with deli turkey, cheese, and a thin creamy spread.

steps.text: Spread each of 2 tortillas with 1 tablespoon cream cheese or mayonnaise.
Layer each tortilla with half of the 4 oz turkey, 2 cheese slices, and optional spinach.
Roll each tortilla tightly, seam-side down, then slice into pinwheels or leave whole as wraps.
